title: tools-catalog.json — a catalogue of MCP capabilities
description: A persistent registry of available MCP servers and their capabilities. The orchestrator reads it during planning and re-checks it before raising any blocker.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last catalogue update, or null.

mcps.description: The list of known MCP servers.

name.description: The MCP server name as it appears in `claude mcp list` (for example github, playwright).

status.description: connected — attached and visible to the session; available — configured or known but not attached right now; unknown — mentioned but unverified.

purpose.description: One line: what the server is for, in human-readable form.

capabilities.description: Key capabilities or tools (for example search_code, create_pull_request).

how_to_connect.description: How to attach it if it is not connected (for example a `claude mcp add ...` command or a link).

source.description: Where the description came from: platform server instructions, `claude mcp list`, or the user.
